description: This file defines a custom Keras layer and a function for filtering object detection results, including applying score thresholds and non-maximum suppression (NMS). It is part of an object detection pipeline, specifically for filtering detection boxes based on confidence scores and overlap criteria.

classes.name: FilterDetections
classes.description: A custom Keras layer for filtering detection boxes using score thresholding and non-maximum suppression (NMS). It processes detection outputs to retain the most relevant boxes based on confidence scores and overlap criteria.

methods.name: filter_detections
methods.description: Filters detection boxes based on score threshold and applies NMS, returning the top detections along with associated scores, labels, and other data.
